theorems.name: Submission.iwl_positive_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 2 ≤ P → SlicingTheorem → IsoperimetricTheorem → LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity → (∀ (Yj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Yj j).boundary) → (⨆ j, (Yj j).boundary.mass) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn (fun j => (Yj j).boundary) Y.boundary → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y.boundary) → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ j, (Tj j).boundary = 0) → (⨆ j, (Tj j).mass) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → ∃ μ : Measure (Eucl P), IsMassMeasure T μ ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < dimensionalUpperDensity μ.toOuterMeasure ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) univ x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
